request.text: Mujhe ek moment pe dhyaan gaya jab ek student ne 2 out of 5 rangon ke liye 'upar aayega, aur upar 5 aayega' kaha, actively applying the fraction rule. Phir baad mein, jab test diya gaya to usne '3,7' sahi jawab diya lekin 'kyun?' ke sawal par clear reason nahi de paya. In dono moments ke beech, aapke khayal se un students ke sochne ka tareeqa mein kya shift aaya tha? Aur agle din jab aap phir se ek set of objects se fraction banane ka kaam denge, aap kya ek chota sa naya tareeqa aazmaana chahengi?
